setup: The polygon is regular and has \([[sides]]\) sides.

steps.say: Walking once around a convex polygon turns the heading through every exterior angle in turn, and the total turn is one full circle, so the exterior angles always add to 360 degrees.
A regular polygon has all its exterior angles equal, so each one is 360 divided by \([[sides]]\). The answer is a whole number of degrees because the side count divides 360.

answer: So one exterior angle of the regular polygon is \([[angle]]\) degrees.
